Biscotti

Made with warmth. Shared with joy.

The story

A visual identity inspired by family recipes, generous flavours and the energy of a growing small business.

Client
Biscotti
Focus
Branding

The identity needed to carry more than the variety of baked goods. It also had to express the warmth, support and invitation to share behind a business built on a family recipe.

Biscotti’s launch after winning the Innovation Garden business accelerator award provided another source of energy for a rich, expressive visual system.
